title: Briefing for 2026-09-28
intro: Good morning. Here is your briefing for 2026-09-28: US markets, global news, and the Philippines, in five minutes.
us: China saw 'surprise' jump in U.S. orders ahead of Trump-Xi summit, private survey shows. Surging Treasury yields pose a brand new problem for Kevin Warsh and the Fed. Global debt tops $365 trillion as economists sound alarm over 'vicious cycle'. Switzerland is keeping rates at 0% — for now. France's fresh budget battle threatens to topple another government. World heads into food crises 'blind' as U.S. aid cuts squeeze UN food agency, experts warn.
global: Iranian minister says only negotiation can end conflict after Trump rejects Hormuz deal. Two mass shootings in South Africa leave 27 dead. Embattled Serbian president resigns, paving way for early elections. Two bodies found after avalanche hits Himalayan climbing group. One dead as nor'easter storm pummels New York and New Jersey. Venezuela releases dozens of political prisoners as election calls grow.
philippines: The stories that shaped us: Rappler opens the Newsbreak Archives. ITCZ affects parts of Philippines; Typhoon Queenie exits PAR. Redemption as John Cabang Tolentino hurdles to Asian Games bronze. Bagunas rues Alas’ lack of support in Asian Games; PNVF apologizes.
outro: That's your briefing. Have a great day.
